aggregation_policy.modal_price: Arrival-weighted average of variety modal prices. This is a derived proxy, not an official consolidated modal price.
aggregation_policy.minimum_price: Minimum of the variety minimum prices
aggregation_policy.maximum_price: Maximum of the variety maximum prices
aggregation_policy.arrivals: Use the source-reported daily total once, converted from metric tonnes to quintals. Do not sum the repeated daily total across variety rows.

quality_notes.known_arrival_exception: Pimpalgaon Baswant Onion on 2025-01-25 has a source total that differs from the remaining variety row after exact duplicate removal. The source-reported daily total is retained and the discrepancy is recorded in daily_series_group_audit.csv.
quality_notes.unresolved_conflicting_groups_outside_se: Manmad conflicts were not included in this selected training batch.
